name: @soon-format/soon
description: SOON (Shape-Oriented Object Notation): lossless, token-efficient encoding of nested JSON for LLM prompts
author: Yasin Ughur <yasinugur.cs@gmail.com>
//browser: Redirects tokencost.js to a Node-free stub for browser bundlers (webpack/vite/rollup/esbuild honour this field). The stub keeps char-cost paths working and raises a clear SoonError on any tokenizer call, so non-Node consumers never resolve node:module.
